title: Wawel Cathedral
source: Retained exact-QID way85151350, current standard PMTiles parent/parts and named northern Sigismund tower/clock POIs, with three useful exterior pictures.
identityStatus: Reviewed approximate individual cathedral correspondence. Named tower/clock POIs resolve three tower identities. Retained55m southern cap is disputed against pictures; no survey-height accuracy claimed.
axis: Native +X east along nave toward choir, +Z south toward gold/dark chapels. Western gable/entry and northern clock POIs resolve signed facing.

orientationControl.basis: West central gable and entrance lie between west chapel projections; clock POIs north and domed chapels south resolve the signed retained plan axis.

clock.name: clock
clock.basis: Northwestern clock POIs and photographed green two-stage cap resolve identity. Retain the mapped45m upper crown; other stage splits are estimates.

silver.name: silver
silver.basis: Southwestern tower corresponds to the named Silver Bells crypt. Use mapped36m lower component as approximate overall crown. Overlapping55m tagged cap conflicts with both inspected photographs and is retained as a disputed input, not adopted as a tall southern tower.

sigismund.name: sigismund
sigismund.basis: Named current PMTiles tower POI/building north of the nave. No tagged height;41m crown and roof stage splits are picture-led estimates.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Main35m roof,22m lower choir,12m west chapels and45m north crown retained as nominal map heights. South55m cap conflicts with pictures/named Silver Bells crypt; use36m lower component for that crown. Northern Sigismund41m and all intermediate roof/drum/gable splits are estimates. Exact heights unverified.
